description: Ask Gretl for command help, for example ols, summary, open, arima, or gnuplot. By default this also requires opening the help workflow in the visible Gretl GUI.

displayInGretl.description: Open a visible Gretl GUI script window for this help request. Defaults to true outside CI.

requireGui.description: Require the visible Gretl GUI to open for this workflow. Defaults to true outside CI.

name: gretl_help
